fire: Candidates should attach a recent passport photo to the online form.
Results are stored in the national exam database for five years.
To find a course, go to the portal and search by subject code.
Inspection reports are kept in the station's online public file.
Applicants must list a referee who can confirm their work history.
Register as a volunteer through the county website before May.
Older papers are available in the exam archive under Resources.
Upload a scanned copy of your ID in the documents section.
quiet: Candidates should arrive thirty minutes early on the morning of the test.
The fee for the exam is forty dollars, payable at the door.
Classes begin on the first Monday of September each year.
The station broadcasts the news every evening at six.
Applicants must have at least two years of work experience.
The county thanks everyone who helped clean the park in May.
The exam lasts three hours and includes a short break.
Bring a pen and a calculator to the exam hall.
